cong_thuc.ten: Ve bieu do co ban + Recommended Charts
cong_thuc.giai_thich: Boi den ca tieu de + so lieu truoc khi Insert thi Excel tu nhan series va truc. Recommended Charts goi y kieu phu hop theo dang du lieu.
cong_thuc.vi_du: Boi den A1:B6 (Ten NV + Doanh thu) > Insert > Column > Clustered Column. Neu phan van thi Insert > Recommended Charts > chon preview dep nhat.

cong_thuc.ten: Tieu de chart lien ket o (linked title)
cong_thuc.giai_thich: Tieu de khong phai text chet ma la cong thuc tham chieu o. Doi noi dung o thi tieu de chart tu doi theo, tien cho bao cao dong.
cong_thuc.vi_du: C5='Loi nhuan Q1' > click title > =C5 > Enter. Doi C5 thanh 'Loi nhuan Q2' thi chart tu doi.

cong_thuc.giai_thich: Dao thu tu hien thi nhan truc ngang/doc ma khong can dao du lieu nguon. Dung khi chart hien GX5..GX1 muon thanh GX1..GX5.
cong_thuc.vi_du: Truc dang GX5 o tren, GX1 o duoi > Format Axis > tich Reverse > thanh GX1..GX5 tu tren xuong.

cong_thuc.ten: Data Label 1 diem (single point) vs ca chuoi
cong_thuc.giai_thich: Excel phan biet chon series (all) va chon point (1 cot). Click don 2 lan lien tiep se mo edit text thay vi chon point; phai click-chunghi-click.
cong_thuc.vi_du: Click cot GX3 lan 1 (ca 5 cot sang) > click lai rieng cot GX3 > Add Data Label hien 24. Click 1 diem > Add Data Labels hien ca 5 so. Click so 24 + Delete de xoa 1 label.

cong_thuc.ten: Dinh dang Data Label: vi tri + so
cong_thuc.giai_thich: Cot ngang thuong de Inside Base (trang, dam) hoac Outside End (den). Cot doc cao de Outside End tranh de len cot. Number format rieng cho label khong anh huong o nguon.
cong_thuc.vi_du: Chart cot ngang: Inside Base + chu trang + Bold. Label %: Number > Custom `#.00%` giu 2 le (67.25%), hoac `#%` gon (67%).

cong_thuc.ten: Chart Elements (+), Legend, Gridlines, Data Table
cong_thuc.giai_thich: Nut + la cong tac tong cho thanh phan. Legend giai thich mau series; Data Table hien bang so duoi chart; Gridlines la duong ke don vi; Axis Titles dat ten truc.
cong_thuc.vi_du: Bat Legend Top: xanh=Doanh thu, vang=Ke hoach. Tat Gridlines doc cho gon. Bat Data Table khi sep muon vua chart vua so.

cong_thuc.ten: Ve chart tu o trong (Select Data Source)
cong_thuc.giai_thich: Chart trang vi chua co Source. Phai nap thu cong: Series Name (ten chuoi), Series Values (vung so), Axis Labels (vung ten). Cach nhanh: nhap Range A1:C6 mot lan.
cong_thuc.vi_du: Add Series Name=`Doanh thu`, Values=C2:C6; Edit Horizontal Labels=A2:A6 (GX1..GX5). Hoac Range=A1:C6 tu nhan ca 2 series.

cong_thuc.giai_thich: Keo handle nhanh cho du lieu lien ke; Add Series chac chan cho du lieu roi rac/khac sheet. Xong bat Legend Top phan biet mau.
cong_thuc.vi_du: Du lieu Them cot Ke hoach (12,35,29,15,20). Keo bien xanh tu cot Doanh thu sang cot Ke hoach -> chart co 2 mau.

cong_thuc.giai_thich: Combo tron 2 kieu bieu do trong 1 chart: cot cho san luong, line cho ke hoach/%. Excel 2016+ co san muc Combo; ban cu phai doi tung series thu cong.
cong_thuc.vi_du: Doanh thu giu Column; Ke hoach chuyen Line mau cam. Chart vua thay cot vua thay duong muc tieu.

cong_thuc.ten: Secondary Axis (truc phu) cho % hoan thanh
cong_thuc.giai_thich: % (0-100%) rat nho so voi Doanh thu/Ke hoach (chuc, tram) nen chung truc se bet duoi day. Secondary Axis tao truc phai 0-100% rieng, truc trai giu gia tri tuyet doi.
cong_thuc.vi_du: Cot % = Thuc hien/Ke hoach (vd 70%). Dua vao chart thay cot be tit > chuyen Secondary Axis + doi sang Line > hien ro 70% tren truc phai.

cong_thuc.giai_thich: Gap Width = khoang cach giua cac nhom cot; % cang nho cot cang to. Overlap = do chong giua cac cot trong cung nhom (combo). Chinh de chart thoang, cot map.
cong_thuc.vi_du: Gap Width 219% (mac dinh) cot gay > keo ve 70% cot to, dep. Overlap 0% cho 2 cot canh nhau khong de.

cong_thuc.ten: Dinh dang Line Ke hoach: No line + Marker
cong_thuc.giai_thich: Ke hoach dang duong ngang muc tieu nen an line, chi giu marker gach ngang de nhin nhu nguong. Dep hon line lien tuc cat ngang cot.
cong_thuc.vi_du: Ke hoach: Line None + Marker Built-in loai gach ngang `-`, size 10, mau cam. Moi cot co 1 gach muc tieu.

cong_thuc.ten: Cot % hoan thanh + format % tuy chinh
cong_thuc.giai_thich: % = Thuc hien chia Ke hoach. Format Percent nhan 100 + them %. `#.00%` giu 2 le, `#%` gon. Can xu ly chia 0.
cong_thuc.vi_du: Thuc 70 / Ke hoach 100 = 0.7 > Percent = 70%. Format `#.00%` hien 67.25% chinh xac thi dua.

cong_thuc.ten: Bieu do tuong tac chon Quy: IF + OR + Validation
cong_thuc.giai_thich: OR cho 2 dieu kien dung: chon ON (hien all) hoac chon trung ten Quy cua cot do. $C$2 co dinh tuyet doi, C$4 co dinh dong de keo khong lech tieu de. Rong "" lam chart tu bo diem trong.
cong_thuc.vi_du: C2=Quy1 -> chi cot Quy1 co so, con lai "" nen chart chi hien Quy1. C2=ON -> ca 4 quy hien. Tieu de chart link E1 tu doi 'Doanh thu Quy1'.

cong_thuc.ten: Nhan Total + CHAR(10) lam Axis Label 2 dong
cong_thuc.giai_thich: CHAR(10) la ky tu xuong dong. Noi Ten + xuong dong + Tong 4 quy de nhan truc vua ten vua tong (vd GX1 xuong dong 57). Bat Wrap Text moi hien 2 dong, tang Row Height.
cong_thuc.vi_du: GX2 tong 163 -> nhan 'GX2< xuong dong>163'. Gan labels = vung Total moi -> cot chart nhom theo nhan co tong.

quiz.cau: Ve chart nhanh nhat lam the nao?
quiz.A: Boi den vung > Insert > chon loai chart
quiz.giai_thich: Boi den truoc roi Insert la cach chuan; F1 khong phai ve chart.

quiz.cau: Khi khong biet chon kieu chart nao thi dung gi?
quiz.B: Recommended Charts de Excel goi y
quiz.giai_thich: Recommended dua preview theo dang du lieu.

quiz.cau: Du lieu doanh thu theo thoi gian nen dung chart nao?
quiz.giai_thich: Chuoi thoi gian hop Column/Line; Pie chi hop ty trong 1 thoi diem.

quiz.cau: De tieu de chart tu doi theo o C5 lam the nao?
quiz.D: Click title > Formula Bar go = > click C5 > Enter
quiz.giai_thich: Lien ket title voi o giup bao cao dong.

quiz.cau: Truc dang GX5..GX1 muon doi GX1..GX5 thi lam gi?
quiz.A: Format Axis > tich Categories in reverse order
quiz.giai_thich: Reverse categories dao thu tu hien thi ma khong dao nguon.

quiz.cau: Mo hop Format Axis/Series nhanh bang phim gi?
quiz.giai_thich: Ctrl+1 mo Format cho doi tuong dang chon.

quiz.cau: Click 1 lan vao cot chart thi chon gi?
quiz.giai_thich: Click 1 = series; click lan 2 moi = 1 point.

quiz.cau: Muon chon rieng cot GX3 de gan label thi thao tac nao dung?
quiz.D: Click 1 lan chon all, dung 1 nhip roi click lan 2 vao GX3
quiz.giai_thich: Click-click cach nhau moi chon single point; double-click thanh edit.

quiz.cau: Hien gia tri 1 cot GX3 lam the nao?
quiz.A: Chon rieng GX3 > chuot phai > Add Data Label
quiz.giai_thich: Add Data Label cho point dang chon, vd hien 24.

quiz.cau: Hien gia tri ca 5 NV mot lan lam the nao?
quiz.B: Chon ca series (click 1 lan) > Add Data Labels
quiz.giai_thich: Chon all roi Add mot lan nhanh nhat.

quiz.cau: Chart cot ngang thi vi tri label nao de doc nhat?
quiz.C: Inside Base (chu trang dam) hoac Outside End
quiz.D: De mac dinh den tren nen toi
quiz.giai_thich: Inside Base + trang dam noi bat tren cot ngang; Outside End cho cot doc cao.

quiz.cau: Gridlines doc bi roi thi xu ly the nao?
quiz.D: Click Gridlines + Delete de chart gon
quiz.giai_thich: Gridlines chi la ke don vi, xoa cho dep khi da co label.

quiz.cau: Nut + canh chart de lam gi?
quiz.A: Them/bot Chart Elements (Titles, Data Table, Gridlines, Legend, Trendline)
quiz.giai_thich: Nut + la trung tam dieu khien thanh phan chart.

quiz.cau: Legend trong chart 2 series co tac dung gi?
quiz.B: Giai thich mau: xanh=Doanh thu, vang=Ke hoach
quiz.giai_thich: Bat Legend Top de nguoi doc biet mau nao la gi.

quiz.cau: Ve chart tu o trong thi ban dau chart the nao?
quiz.C: Trang, khong du lieu vi chua co Source
quiz.giai_thich: Phai nap Source qua Select Data.

quiz.cau: Nap du lieu cho chart trang o dau?
quiz.D: Chart Design > Select Data > Add Series + Edit Labels
quiz.giai_thich: Select Data de nap Name/Values/Labels.

quiz.cau: Them cot Ke hoach nhanh bang keo handle thi lam the nao?
quiz.A: Click chart > keo goc vung xanh sang cot Ke hoach
quiz.giai_thich: Handle xanh mo rong vung nguon them series vang.

quiz.cau: Cot % hoan thanh tinh bang cong thuc nao?
quiz.B: =Thuc hien / Ke hoach roi format Percent
quiz.giai_thich: Ty le hoan thanh = thuc dat chia muc tieu.

quiz.cau: Vi sao dua cot % vao chart chung truc thi cot be tit duoi day?
quiz.C: Vi % (0-1) qua nho so voi Doanh thu/Ke hoach (chuc-tram)
quiz.giai_thich: Chenh lech thang do lam % bet; phai dung Secondary Axis.

quiz.cau: Chuyen series % sang truc phu o dau?
quiz.D: Format Data Series > Series Options > Secondary Axis
quiz.giai_thich: Secondary Axis tao truc phai 0-100% rieng.

quiz.cau: Combo chart trong bai ket hop kieu nao?
quiz.A: Doanh thu Column + Ke hoach/% Line
quiz.giai_thich: Cot cho san luong, line cho muc tieu/%.

quiz.cau: Doi kieu rieng 1 series thi dung lenh nao?
quiz.B: Chuot phai series > Change Series Chart Type > chon Combo
quiz.giai_thich: Change Series chi doi 1 series, giu series con lai.

quiz.cau: Gap Width co tac dung gi?
quiz.C: Dieu chinh khoang cach giua nhom cot; % nho cot to ra
quiz.giai_thich: Gap 219% cot gay; keo ve 60-80% cot map dep.

quiz.cau: Ke hoach dang Line muon dep nhu nguong gach ngang thi format the nao?
quiz.D: Line: No line + Marker Built-in gach ngang size 10
quiz.giai_thich: No line + marker tao gach muc tieu tren moi cot.

quiz.cau: Format % 67.25% gon con 67% thi lam the nao?
quiz.giai_thich: #.00% giu 2 le, #% gon khong le.

quiz.cau: Data Validation cho o chon Quy C2 gom gia tri nao?
quiz.B: ON, Quy1, Quy2, Quy3, Quy4 (khop tieu de)
quiz.C: Tuy y, khac tieu de cung duoc
quiz.giai_thich: Ten list phai khop tieu de cot de IF+OR so sanh.

quiz.cau: Cong thuc loc tuong tac o C3 la gi?
quiz.giai_thich: ON hoac trung ten Quy thi lay so tu sheet Du lieu, nguoc lai rong.

quiz.cau: Vi sao phai co dinh $C$2 va C$4 trong cong thuc tuong tac?
quiz.D: De keo copy khap bang khong lech o chon Quy va dong tieu de
quiz.giai_thich: $C$2 giu o lua chon, C$4 giu dong tieu de khi keo.

quiz.cau: Tieu de chart tu doi theo Quy duoc lam the nao?
quiz.A: Tao o phu E1='Doanh thu '&IF($C$2="ON","ca nam",$C$2) roi link title =E1
quiz.giai_thich: Title link o phu nen doi theo C2: Quy1 hay ca nam.

quiz.cau: CHAR(10) trong bai de lam gi?
quiz.B: Xuong dong trong nhan: =Ten & CHAR(10) & SUM(4 quy)
quiz.giai_thich: Noi ten + xuong dong + tong de nhan 2 dong.

quiz.cau: De nhan CHAR(10) hien 2 dong can bat gi?
quiz.C: Wrap Text + tang chieu cao hang
quiz.giai_thich: Wrap moi hien xuong dong; khong thi dinh 1 dong.

quiz.cau: Sau khi tao cot Total = Ten & CHAR(10) & SUM thi gan vao chart o dau?
quiz.D: Select Data > Edit Horizontal Axis Labels = vung Total
quiz.giai_thich: Gan lai labels de truc hien ten + tong.

quiz.cau: Loi khien chart tuong tac trang tron du lieu dung nhung C2 co gia tri?
quiz.A: Ten trong Validation khac tieu de (thua space/Quy 1 vs Quy1) nen OR FALSE
quiz.giai_thich: So sanh chuoi can khop tuyet doi.

quiz.cau: Loi hien 0.6725 thay vi 67.25% la do dau?
quiz.B: De dinh dang General thay vi Percent
quiz.giai_thich: Phai format Percent hoac Custom #.00%.

quiz.cau: Xoa chart nhanh lam the nao?
quiz.C: Click vien chart (chon ca chart) > Delete hoac chuot phai > Cut
quiz.giai_thich: Chon ca doi tuong chart roi xoa.

quiz.cau: Khi kho click chon series % nho thi lam the nao?
quiz.D: Dung dropdown Chart Format (chon series) hoac Select Data
quiz.giai_thich: Dropdown Format giup chon chinh xac series nho.

quiz.cau: De so sanh Thuc hien vs Ke hoach ro nhat thi bo cuc nao duoc chon?
quiz.A: Column (Thuc hien) + Line marker (Ke hoach) + Secondary Line (%)
quiz.giai_thich: Combo phan tach vai tro: cot san luong, line muc tieu/%.

quiz.cau: Xoa 1 label rieng (so 24 cua GX3) lam the nao?
quiz.giai_thich: Chon dung label roi Delete chi xoa 1 diem.

quiz.cau: Muốn % hien tren truc phai 0-100% ma truc trai van giu Doanh thu thi can gi?
quiz.giai_thich: Hai thang do rieng biet tren 2 truc.

quiz.cau: Tong GX2 = 163 trong bai tinh tu dau?
quiz.giai_thich: SUM 4 quy roi noi vao nhan bang CHAR(10).
